rationale: This change strengthens the existing Permanent Canonical + Promotion Gate so every workflow linked to Current Host by filename or semantic marker is fail-closed checked for immutable 40-hex GitHub Action pins. It changes only CI/policy validation behavior and adds no runner, provider, device/resource allocation, host service, proof recipe, runtime execution path, evidence claim, hardware behavior, or promotion authority. Therefore no fresh physical Current Host requalification or FULL-525 replay is required.
